commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=9a23d8200284e9485155e95e8500f5a0fc9b152e
git fetch origin main
git checkout main
git reset --hard origin/main
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
printf '%s' '' | base64 --decode > scripts/test_realtime_offcall_lab.py
set +e
RED_OUTPUT=$(python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_realtime_offcall_lab.py' 2>&1)
RED_RC=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$RED_OUTPUT"
test "$RED_RC" -ne 0
printf '%s\n' "$RED_OUTPUT" | grep -q "No module named 'realtime_offcall_lab'"
echo realtime_offcall_lab_red_verified=true
printf '%s' '' | base64 --decode > scripts/realtime_offcall_lab.py
python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_realtime_offcall_lab.py'
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export GRADLE_BIN="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"
bash scripts/verify_host.sh
git diff --check
git add scripts/realtime_offcall_lab.py scripts/test_realtime_offcall_lab.py
git commit -m 'feat: add one-command realtime off-call lab'
git push origin HEAD:main
echo pushed_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo realtime_offcall_lab_green=true
